scope: ordinary linear AecRun through normal return including real native AecClmExecute, run/skip bookkeeping, control-index advancement and previous-mean publication
limitations: DCG and register-value conversion are explicit successful no-op boundaries; call counts are checked.
Preprocessing supplies run flag and current measurements; missing-statistics/manual/HDR/iris branches are excluded.
Successful control paths only; conversion failures and partially mutated error state are not covered.
No live writes or physical frame association are introduced.
